title: Microsoft Windows win32k.sys Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Windows. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must run a malicious executable. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Dynamic Data Exchange objects. The issue lies in the destruction of DDE objects within a thread. An attacker can leverage this to escalate their privileges and execute code under the context of SYSTEM.
